visibility: All observations in this file are public; no blind-holdout claim.

records.measurement: At 0.05 mM catalyst and 0.50 V versus Fc+/0, controlled-potential electrolysis yields N2 for Ru–bcs–NH3 and Ru–bda–NH3: bcs replicates 774.68/798.26 equivalents N2 and bda replicates 289.99/279.83 equivalents N2 over 45 h. These are whole-cycle observations, not local rate constants.
The Py-containing molecular models have different axial ligands from the NH3 experimental catalyst labels; representativeness must be stated.
